fields.name: Grain query definitions
fields.definition: The per-grain-type registration (`OrleansDbQueryDefinitions`, `OrleansShardQueryDefinitions`) of the read, write and clear Query objects that grain persistence uses for that grain type. It also specifies whether the read query returns state as output parameters or as a result set. It is registered in the persistence options keyed by grain type; a grain type with no registration fails on first use.
